title: Privacy Policy
description: How Integra SGI handles the personal data of the organizations and people who use the platform.

blocks.p: This policy explains how Integra SGI collects, uses, keeps, protects and deletes personal data. We process data lawfully, fairly, transparently and securely, in line with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), Portuguese Law No. 58/2019 and, where applicable, the Brazilian General Data Protection Law (LGPD, Law No. 13.709/2018).
The platform's security and privacy practices use the ISO/IEC 27001:2022 and ISO/IEC 27701:2025 standards as their reference.
It applies to people who use the platform, people who represent organizations, people who contact us and anyone else whose data is processed as part of the service.

When an organization enters other people's personal data into the platform to manage its own processes, that organization is the controller of that data and Integra SGI processes it as a processor, only on the organization's documented instructions and under the applicable data processing agreement.
We only collect the data needed to provide, maintain and improve the service.

blocks.p: This data is linked to your account. The indicators the team sees are aggregated (totals, medians and ranges) and do not show individual accounts.

list: Through the contact form: name, email and message text. The platform does not store the message in the database; it sends it by email to the controller's mailbox.
If you write to us directly by email: your address, the subject, the content and the date, as well as our reply.
Sign-ins, failed attempts, sign-outs, changes to the password, account details, profile and photo, data exports and deletions, always with the date.
For administration actions on a company, the log records which account was affected; that reference is removed when the account is deleted.

blocks.p: The security log does not include the IP address.

list: IP address: used only to limit abusive attempts (sign-in, registration, email confirmation, password recovery, contact and account deletion). It is not stored in clear: we store a code computed from the IP with a secret key (keyed hash), combined with the type of operation and, for some operations, the email, plus a counter. This record stops having any effect after at most 1 hour and is deleted automatically at the next cleanup, which runs every 15 minutes. Even so, it is pseudonymized personal data and is treated as such.

Hosting technical logs: the hosting provider (Vercel) logs requests to the site and the API, which may include the IP address, the requested page, the date and the browser type. The provider keeps these logs for the short period of the contracted service, and they are used only to diagnose failures and security incidents. The application itself does not write personal data to its technical logs.
Email delivery logs: the email provider (Resend) keeps, for the period of the contracted service, the delivery data of the messages we send (recipient, subject and delivery status).

We do not use the data for advertising, we do not sell it and we do not use it for purposes incompatible with those stated. We do not make solely automated decisions with legal or similarly significant effects on you.

blocks.p: We only use one essential cookie:

list: Name: integra_session.
Purpose: keeping you signed in.
Maximum duration: 7 days.
Attributes: HttpOnly (scripts cannot read it), Secure (only sent over HTTPS) and SameSite=Lax.

blocks.p: We do not use advertising or analytics cookies, or tracking technologies. We do not store authentication tokens, passwords or other personal data in the browser's local storage. If we ever use non-essential tools, we will update this policy and ask for your consent before enabling them.

sections.title: 7. Who processes data on our behalf

blocks.p: We do not sell, rent or trade personal data. For the service to work, we use these processors:

list: Vercel Inc.: hosting of the site and the API, and the related technical logs.
Neon Inc.: database, file storage (profile photos) and database backups.
Resend Inc.: sending emails.

GitHub, Inc.: hosting of the source code and running of the automated publishing and maintenance processes, including database updates and the automatic data cleanup; during these processes it has technical access to the database.

blocks.p: These providers only process data as needed for the service, on our instructions, under confidentiality and security obligations, and delete or return the data at the end of the service, under the data processing agreements (Art. 28 GDPR) we have with each of them.

Some of these providers may process data outside the European Economic Area, notably in the United States. In those cases we apply Chapter V of the GDPR: the transfer relies on a European Commission adequacy decision (including the EU-US Data Privacy Framework, only where the provider is certified) or on standard contractual clauses approved by the European Commission, with additional measures where the risk assessment calls for them.

blocks.p: Sessions, links, attempt-limiting records and old security log entries are cleaned up automatically every 15 minutes.

If you delete the account in your profile, your data is deleted immediately from the database and from file storage. If you request it by email, we handle the request within one month. Backups that still contain that data stay protected and cease to exist at the end of their period. If a backup ever has to be restored, we re-apply the deletions made after that backup's date.
Under the GDPR and, where applicable, the LGPD, you have the right to:

list: Access: know whether we process your data and obtain a copy.
Rectification: correct inaccurate or incomplete data.
Erasure: ask for your data to be deleted, where the law allows.
Restriction of processing: ask us to temporarily stop using the data, in the cases provided by law.
Portability: receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format.
Objection: object to processing based on legitimate interest.
Withdraw consent, where processing is based on it, without affecting processing already carried out.
Lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority (section 15).

blocks.p: In your profile, under "Your data", you can download your data and delete the account; elsewhere in the profile you can correct most of the information. For other requests, contact {{email}}. Requests are free of charge, except in the cases provided by law. We reply within one month, which may be extended by two further months where necessary, in which case we will let you know. Where the LGPD applies, we also respect the deadlines and procedures it sets.
We apply technical and organizational measures that protect the confidentiality, integrity and availability of data, adjusted to the risks:

list: Communication: all traffic uses HTTPS, with security headers that prevent the page from being embedded in other sites and limit the code the browser runs.
Credentials: passwords protected with Argon2id, never stored as text; sessions with secure cookies that scripts cannot read, stored only as a hash in the database.

Access control: restricted administrative access, least privilege, separation between customer and administration accounts, and limiting of abusive attempts. Deleting a company requires the administrator's password.

Stored data: files in private storage, accessible only through temporary signed links; restricted access to the database and infrastructure secrets; no secrets in public code or in the code that runs in the browser.
Traceability: a log of security-relevant operations, without IP address, accessible only to the Integra SGI team.
Continuity: database backups and a documented recovery procedure.

blocks.p: We have a procedure to identify, assess, record and respond to security incidents. In the event of a personal data breach, we assess the nature of the incident, the data and people affected, the possible consequences and the measures to limit its effects. Where the breach is likely to result in a risk to people's rights and freedoms, we notify the supervisory authority within 72 hours of becoming aware of it (Art. 33 GDPR) and, where the risk is high, we also inform the people affected (Art. 34).

When an organization uses the platform to process data about employees, suppliers, customers or other people, it is the controller of that data and must ensure it has a legal basis, was obtained lawfully and is necessary and proportionate. Integra SGI only processes that data on the organization's documented instructions and under the applicable data processing agreement. If you send us a request about data an organization entered into the platform, we forward it to that organization and let you know.

We update this policy when there are relevant changes to the platform, the providers or the law. If a change significantly affects how your data is processed, we will let you know on the platform or by other appropriate means. The current version is always on this page, with the date of the last update at the top.
